name: erno.js
description: An engine for twisty puzzles and the permutations underneath them, rendered to SVG. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.three.config.js && npm run types
scripts.build:site: npm run llms && vite build --config site/vite.config.js
scripts.test: node tests/erno.test.js && node tests/twisty.test.js && node tests/algebra.test.js && node tests/readme.test.js && node tests/contrast.test.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run build && npm run check:package
scripts.types: tsc --declaration --allowJs --emitDeclarationOnly --module esnext --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck --outDir dist/types src/erno.js src/three.js

author: DevMartinese
